tools.name: scan_site
tools.title: Scan a site for AI agent readability
tools.description: Runs the agent-ready.dev scanner against a URL and returns structured results: Vercel score, llmstxt.org score, and per-check findings with remediation hints. Scans may take up to ~60s; for larger scans the tool returns a scan id and asks you to poll with get_scan.

url.description: Full URL of the site to scan, e.g. https://example.com. Must be a public http(s) address.

pageLimit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Defaults to your tier's per-scan page limit when omitted.

status.description: Scan status: running, completed, or failed.

vercelScore.description: Score against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec (0–100); null while running.

vercelRating.description: Rating band for the Vercel score.

accessibilityScore.description: Accessibility / layout-stability sub-score (0–100) over the homepage WCAG checks; null when none ran. Separate from the Vercel score.

protocolResults.description: Agent-protocol checks (C-series) that ran — only for endpoints the site actually exposes.

accessibilityChecks.description: Accessibility / layout-stability checks (A-series) run over the homepage.

pollUrl.description: Poll URL while the scan is still running.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.title: Get a previous scan by id
tools.description: Fetches a completed or in-progress scan by its id. Only scans owned by the authenticated API key's user are returned.

id.description: The scan id returned by scan_site (also the share token in a /scan/<id> URL).

status.description: Scan status: running, completed, or failed.

vercelScore.description: Score against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec (0–100); null while running.

vercelRating.description: Rating band for the Vercel score.

accessibilityScore.description: Accessibility / layout-stability sub-score (0–100) over the homepage WCAG checks; null when none ran. Separate from the Vercel score.

protocolResults.description: Agent-protocol checks (C-series) that ran — only for endpoints the site actually exposes.

accessibilityChecks.description: Accessibility / layout-stability checks (A-series) run over the homepage.

pollUrl.description: Poll URL while the scan is still running.

tools.name: ask
tools.title: Ask Agent Ready in natural language
tools.description: Natural-language search (NLWeb /ask) over Agent Ready's own content — scoring methodology, the check registry, the specs it validates, and the content library (explainers, comparisons, how-to guides, glossary). Returns Schema.org-typed result objects. Optional itemType narrows to a corpus type; mode 'summarize' adds an extractive summary.

q.description: Natural-language question to search Agent Ready's docs, scoring methodology, check registry, and content library (explainers, comparisons, how-to guides, glossary).

itemType.description: Restrict results to a content type: methodology, checks, specs, llms-txt, check, page (explainers/guides/glossary), or any (default: all types).

mode.description: "list" (default) returns matching items; "summarize" returns a synthesized answer.
